data.title: Huzhou Gas Signs Three-Year Natural Gas Supply Framework
data.description:
Huzhou Gas Co., Ltd. Class H ( (HK:6661) ) has provided an update.

Huzhou Gas operates in the natural gas industry, with its business focused on the procurement and supply of PNG and LNG within its operating area.

The company entered a three-year framework agreement with Ningbo Intercity on 6 November 2026 to purchase PNG and LNG from 1 January 2027 through 31 December 2029. Because Ningbo Intercity is affiliated with Huzhou Gas’s substantial shareholder ENN (China), the arrangement is a continuing connected transaction requiring regulatory compliance and approval by independent shareholders, while providing an ongoing gas procurement channel for the Group.

data.title: Mega Genomics Renews Meinian and Dr. Yu Cooperation Agreements
data.description:
Mega Genomics Limited ( (HK:6667) ) has shared an update.

Mega Genomics Limited provides testing services, ancillary services and related products to healthcare networks and affiliated medical stakeholders. The renewed arrangements cover supplies to Meinian OneHealth’s group and to Dr. Yu and his associates.

The company signed replacement cooperation agreements with Meinian OneHealth and Dr. Yu as existing arrangements near expiry on 31 December 2026. The agreements set transaction caps totaling up to RMB628.2 million annually for Meinian and RMB50.3 million for Dr. Yu by 2029, while requiring independent shareholder approval because the counterparties are connected persons and controlling shareholders.

data.title: Huzhou Gas Redirects RMB77.5 Million Toward Green Energy
data.description:
Huzhou Gas Co., Ltd. Class H ( (HK:6661) ) just unveiled an update.

Huzhou Gas Co., Ltd. operates in the natural-gas utility industry, supplying piped natural gas (PNG) and developing related energy services, including distributed photovoltaic power generation and heat-energy applications. Its business focus includes gas infrastructure, clean-energy expansion and low-carbon transition initiatives.

The company’s board approved a change to the use of approximately RMB77.5 million in unutilised IPO proceeds. The funds, originally earmarked for strategic acquisitions, will instead be allocated to businesses related to green energy and the low-carbon transition, redirecting capital toward the group’s clean-energy strategy while approximately RMB236.9 million has already been utilised for previously designated purposes.

data.title: Solomon Systech Agrees to Acquire Hong Kong Office Property
data.description:
Solomon Systech (International) Ltd. ( (HK:2878) ) has provided an announcement.

Solomon Systech, a semiconductor company specializing in display-driver ICs and system solutions, serves consumer electronics, smart-device, healthcare and industrial markets. Its products support displays and connected applications across smartphones, tablets, televisions, computers, wearables and smart-home equipment.

A wholly owned subsidiary agreed to acquire Hong Kong office premises at 83 Wing Hong Street for HK$130.408 million, funded through internal resources. The approximately 11,646-square-foot property will support the group’s office relocation, reduce reliance on leased premises and limit long-term rental costs and exposure to rental fluctuations.

data.title: Ruifeng Green Energy Proposes HK$274.9 Million Share Subscriptions
data.description:
An announcement from China Ruifeng Renewable Energy Holdings Ltd. ( (HK:0527) ) is now available.

Ruifeng Green Energy AI Computing Holdings Ltd., formerly China Ruifeng Renewable Energy Holdings Ltd., operates under a name reflecting green energy and AI computing activities, although the release provides no details on its specific products or services. The company announced three conditional share subscriptions involving Filled Converge, RuiYuan and Mr. Yuan, totaling approximately HK$274.9 million at HK$0.23 per share.

The subscriptions comprise 321.7 million shares for HK$74 million, 330 million shares for HK$75.9 million and 543.5 million shares for HK$125 million. Consideration will be settled through convertible notes and an outstanding amount owed to Mr. Yuan, while the proposed issuance would materially expand the company’s share capital and potentially dilute existing shareholders; an independent financial adviser has also been appointed.

data.title: HG Semiconductor to Redeem Note Through Shares and Convertible Bonds
data.description:
The latest update is out from HG Semiconductor Limited ( (HK:6908) ).

HG Semiconductor agreed to redeem in full a promissory note issued in connection with its acquisition of Red Mont HK Limited. The settlement comprises 115.5 million new shares issued at HK$0.22 each for HK$25.4 million and bonds convertible into 61.5 million shares at HK$0.26 each for the remaining HK$16 million.

The consideration shares would represent about 9.86% of the existing share capital, while the conversion shares would represent about 5.25%, creating potential dilution for existing shareholders. Because the note holder is wholly owned by a substantial shareholder, the transaction is classified as a connected transaction and requires independent shareholder approval, with separate listing applications planned for the shares but not the bonds.

data.title: BenQ BM Medical Revenue Rises as Operating Profit Declines
data.description:
BenQ BM Holding Cayman Corp. ( (HK:2581) ) has shared an announcement.

BenQ BM Holding Cayman Corp. is a Cayman Islands-incorporated investment holding company within Qisda Corporation’s group, with reported activities focused on the medical segment. Qisda, listed in Taiwan, is deemed to control about 74.61% of the company, while the release provides no detailed medical product breakdown.

For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, medical segment external revenue increased to NTD9.53 billion from NTD8.54 billion, but operating profit fell to NTD182.7 million from NTD426.5 million, indicating materially weaker profitability despite growth. The figures come from Qisda’s accounts under Taiwan accounting rules and may not be directly comparable with the group’s IFRS results.

data.title: LifeTech Accelerates Vesting of Employee Equity Incentives
data.description:
LifeTech Scientific Corporation ( (HK:1302) ) has shared an announcement.

LifeTech Scientific Corporation’s board approved the full vesting and exercisability of unvested share options and awards held by executive directors, senior management and other employees, recognizing their contributions to the Group. The measures cover options across the company’s 2011 and 2021 schemes and awards under its 2022 scheme, while extending the exercise periods for relevant options. The action increases immediate access to equity incentives for key personnel and may strengthen employee retention and alignment with shareholders, although it could also increase potential share dilution if options are exercised.

data.title: RUSAL Pays 135.6 Million Rubles in Bond Coupon
data.description:
An update from United Co RUSAL ( (HK:0486) ) is now available.

United Company RUSAL reported paying 135.6 million Russian rubles in coupon income on its BO-001P-11 exchange-traded bonds for the 26th coupon period, covering October 7 to November 6, 2026. The payment amounted to 13.56 rubles per bond.

The coupon was calculated using the Bank of Russia’s key rate, set seven days before calculation, plus a 2.50% annual spread. The disclosure confirms the company’s latest interest-payment obligation to bondholders has been met.

data.title: Casablanca Group Agrees HK$50 Million Subsidiary Sale and Special Dividend
data.description:
Casablanca Group Ltd. ( (HK:2223) ) just unveiled an announcement.

Casablanca Group agreed to sell its wholly owned subsidiary to a buyer for HK$50 million under a conditional share purchase agreement signed on November 6, 2026. The company also approved renewing its lease agreements for three years from 2027 through 2029, on substantially unchanged annual rent and terms.

The board recommended a special dividend of HK$0.31 per share, totaling approximately HK$80 million, subject to shareholder approval of the disposal. An independent board committee will advise shareholders on the transaction and lease renewals, with the arrangements subject to consideration at an extraordinary general meeting.

data.title: CHALIECO Proposes RMB6.56 Billion Guinea Alumina EPC Project
data.description:
China Aluminum International Engineering Corporation Limited Class H ( (HK:2068) ) has shared an update.

CHALIECO is an engineering contractor focused on aluminum and alumina projects, providing engineering, procurement and construction services for major industrial developments. The announcement concerns the company’s involvement in an overseas Guinea project.

The board approved a proposal for CHALIECO to act as EPC general contractor for Chalco Guinea’s alumina project in Guinea’s Boffa region, with a proposed fixed lump-sum value of approximately RMB6,555.57 million. Because Chalco Guinea is a fellow Chinalco subsidiary, the transaction is connected and subject to disclosure and independent shareholders’ approval requirements; two directors with Chinalco positions abstained, while the contract remained unsigned at the announcement date.

data.title: CHALIECO Transfers Jiuye Sanwei Stake for RMB100 Million
data.description:

China Aluminum International Engineering Corporation Limited operates in the aluminum and nonferrous-metals engineering sector, providing project and related industrial services to support metals production and development.

data.title: Guotai Haitong Commits HTUT Shares to Partial Offers
data.description:
Guotai Junan Securities Co., Ltd. Class H ( (HK:2611) ) has issued an announcement.

Guotai Haitong Securities, a China-based securities and financial-services firm, announced an irrevocable undertaking tied to partial cash offers for Haitong UnitTrust International Financial Leasing (HTUT). Through subsidiaries, it agreed to dispose of 1.245 billion domestic shares at RMB1.85 each and 4.559 billion H shares at HK$2.16 each, subject to the offer terms.

Because SIG owns about 20.46% of Guotai Haitong and wholly owns the offerors, the transaction is both discloseable and connected under Hong Kong listing rules. The board formed an independent committee and appointed an independent financial adviser, with the proposed disposal requiring independent shareholders’ approval and adding governance oversight for investors.

data.title: LifeTech Plans HK$1.48 Billion Share Subscription and Leadership Overhaul
data.description:
The latest announcement is out from LifeTech Scientific Corporation ( (HK:1302) ).

LifeTech has conditionally agreed to issue 926.34 million new shares in two tranches at HK$1.60 each, representing about 20% of its existing share capital and 16.67% on an enlarged basis. The subscription is expected to generate approximately HK$1.48 billion in gross proceeds and HK$1.47 billion net, with 60% earmarked for international expansion and 40% for broadening its product portfolio and pipeline.

Subject to the first tranche completing, Xie Yuehui will step down as executive director, chairman and chief executive officer, while Li Zhenfu is proposed as chairman and non-executive director and Xie Yang as executive director and chief executive officer. Zhao Jonathon Zhong is proposed as a non-executive director, and Yuan Quanwei as chief financial officer, company secretary and authorized representative, marking a broad leadership transition alongside the fundraising.
